fields.description: Checkins for this employee get created from BOTH their own, correct Employee.attendance_device_id AND every code listed below - this never changes or touches the Employee record's own clocking ID.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: One or more raw clocking codes that should resolve to this Employee, in addition to their own attendance_device_id - e.g. a second/old machine ID, or a device known to be misconfigured for this person. Checked only for codes that don't already match some Employee's own attendance_device_id directly, so it can never redirect a code away from its correct owner.
fields.label: Override Codes
